result.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?
result.markdown:
For a small customer support team, I'd recommend **Freshdesk or Help Scout** as the best starting points.

The right choice depends on whether you prioritise affordability, simplicity, automation, or handling support across multiple channels.

You generally want help desk software that gives you\:

- A shared inbox so the team can manage customer requests together.
- Ticket assignment and ownership so nothing gets missed.
- Automation for repetitive tasks.
- Knowledge base and self-service options.
- Reporting on response times, resolution times and team performance.
- Integrations with the tools you already use.

## Best help desk software compared

My shortlist for 2026. Prices are indicative USD list prices, generally based on annual billing; check regional pricing before purchasing.

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

From \$19/agent/month.

- Strong ticket management and automation.
- Knowledge base and customer portal.
- Good reporting and growth options.
- Best for teams wanting a proper ticketing system.

[Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![Help Scout Pricing & Reviews 2026 | Techjockey.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Vc4OfpksDG0SYFQO2E4DBpLJOQUw-u5-79PbQ0FAzOhtZzreG-oym8CqN3NjPdhGdB9thM6s19ul7-oCFNRzT3e41X5EcsNhFO6CSeSVnQFxwuN5lbEVYZwGfBuSEovHpvvj_dafp0K7DuHOnDsBXe2D-P9xjZT98_6jjWq8rmebpqXoOtAcpGFSu_5ylm1p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for simplicity)

Free plan available; paid from \$25/user/month.

- Excellent shared inbox.
- Easy for new agents to learn.
- Good customer-facing knowledge base.
- Less complex than traditional enterprise help desks.

[Help Scout website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---

![Planning your knowledge base](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c-aP08cOYxkyyv9X77vAO6BTznUrnbcE682O_PNXv85rTzeJ7P8rfPi0zwEy5RuJoItPtTqoOS_qx_th3WBRO5qW1_R1PEH6lnQv9fjQNK8k9Lq0ZpXaKAQ9c430TCrqKQIQ-l-YOuE_UJtZkcQj3vAw0fnqYwhILulvnKb-85lypWsGsBgNPmp7t1d2mt9a?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

Free for up to 3 agents; paid options available.

- Good ticketing and workflow automation.
- Useful CRM integrations.
- Great value for smaller teams.
- Interface can take some getting used to.

[Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

![CXPA Global | CX Day](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Df7ZME9U6OBHF5y7Iy8re15rfxWfkij2J5upWOY6h17xPwPTHy9GzGMO1pjPycv2eahYGXuZJQqpk7Eu-n45330bnP145JuZvq23mLa9ySgQfmrjrLanGhUx6oyklDReusakKYD0C0EVNYz4WHwYHTEn8t4EiNn2pI71GHk_6Pu88F0xspYAogvoagE-Nhjq?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zendesk**

(Best for scaling)

From around £15/agent/month for its basic Support Team plan.

- Powerful ticket routing and workflows.
- Extensive integrations.
- Strong analytics and reporting.
- Can become expensive as requirements grow.

[Zendesk website](https://www.zendesk.co.uk/)

---

![Start with Jira Service Management for free | Atlassian](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uM4_zr83b4l4NmM1nSV9n-_qcjfrVKOuxPjVd73gx7KyLp4jO-EoLoaBgb-wnzT4dOJMtqRxVlhKcCHgED3mPbjfMOmX8twF9kcpfdTu7WM1F8BAmRHTVmHj2otd4g8mJLzkhIxcukSFQezyVfccEH4Alt96s7nt4y4L0fysHDM_D4XG5TaZAI-gyMWPr0Zy?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Jira Service Management**

(Best for internal IT)

Free for up to 3 agents.

- Incident and problem management.
- IT asset and change management.
- Excellent integration with Jira.
- Less suited to a simple customer support inbox.

[Jira Service Management website](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/service-management)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down like this\:

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 2–5 support agents | Help Scout |
| 5–15 agents | Freshdesk |
| Very limited budget | Zoho Desk |
| Complex, multi-channel support | Zendesk |
| Internal IT support | Jira Service Management |
